name: seed
description: Seed-pipeline profile — a shared-iterations pool producer, not a measurement round. ITERATIONS= sets the pool size target (each iteration yields at most one SEEDID line; the runner extracts them into seed-pool.json).
_verdict: apiSla:false and no verdict line — a seed round's success measure is the extracted pool size the runner prints. The loose breaker only stops a hopeless run (dead service, broken data) early instead of burning the full iteration budget.
_sizing: Size ITERATIONS at planned measurement iterations x 1.3: the consumable preflight wants a 1.2x pool, and some seed iterations fail (business rejects, missing TaskId).
